statements.status_notes: CVE-2018-13420 reports a LeakSanitizer false positive for a deliberate one-time allocation in MallocExtension::Register (malloc_extension.cc). The gperftools maintainer closed https://github.com/gperftools/gperftools/issues/1013 as not a bug, Debian marks the issue unimportant with no fix planned for trixie, and Ceph ships libgoogle-perftools4t64 only as a tcmalloc runtime dependency with no attacker-controlled path to trigger unbounded memory growth.

CVE-2018-13420 reports a LeakSanitizer false positive for a deliberate one-time allocation in MallocExtension::Register (malloc_extension.cc). The gperftools maintainer closed https://github.com/gperftools/gperftools/issues/1013 as not a bug, Debian marks the issue unimportant with no fix planned for trixie, and Ceph ships libgoogle-perftools4t64 only as a tcmalloc runtime dependency with no attacker-controlled path to trigger unbounded memory growth.
